disconnect.consequence-undo: This cannot be undone. You'll have to reconnect and re-select the ad account to use Guide again.

choose-framework.title: Choose your funnel framework
choose-framework.description: Select the marketing funnel framework that best fits your growth strategy and customer journey.

AAARRR.title: AAARRR
AAARRR.description: Focuses on the stages of the customer journey: Awareness, Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Revenue, and Referral. This framework is designed to help optimize each step to drive growth and retention.

RACE.title: RACE
RACE.description: A digital marketing planning framework for driving growth through customer interaction and engagement. It focuses on four stages: Reach (awareness), Act (engagement), Convert (purchase), and Engage (long-term retention).

AIDA.title: AIDA
AIDA.description: A classic framework for structuring marketing communications. It focuses on capturing the user's attention, generating interest, building desire, and prompting action (conversion).

choose-stage.title: Choose your funnel stage
choose-stage.description: Select the funnel stage to create a targeted marketing campaign, from awareness to retention, based on your strategy.

awareness.title: Awareness
awareness.description: Attract potential users by making your product discoverable through targeted marketing channels.

acquisition.title: Acquisition
acquisition.description: Convert visitors into leads by capturing their interest through sign-ups or initial actions.

activation.title: Activation
activation.description: Engage users by delivering value early on, helping them experience the core benefit of your product.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: Keep users coming back by maintaining engagement and providing continued value over time.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: Monetize users by turning them into paying customers through relevant product or service offers.

referral.title: Referral
referral.description: Encourage satisfied users to refer others, driving organic growth and increasing your user base.

select-acquisition.title: Select type of the acquisition funnel
select-acquisition.description: Choose the funnel that best fits your current goals — whether it’s quick wins, long-term growth, or unique opportunities.

paid.title: Paid
paid.description: Fast results with immediate impact, but often costly and unsustainable in the long run. Best for quick wins and short-term campaigns.

paid-search-high-intent.title: Paid Search (High Intent)
paid-search-high-intent.description: Targets users actively searching for specific solutions with strong purchase intent via search ads for high-conversion keywords.

paid-search-low-intent.title: Paid Search (Low Intent)
paid-search-low-intent.description: Reaches users researching broader, informational topics through search ads, aiming to nurture them towards a future purchase. keywords.

paid-social.title: Paid Social
paid-social.description: Uses paid social media ads to target specific audiences based on demographics and interests to drive awareness, engagement, or conversions.

organic.title: Organic
organic.description: Steady and reliable results over time, focused on building sustainable growth through consistent efforts without ongoing costs.

organic-search-low-intent.title: Organic Search (Low Intent)
organic-search-low-intent.description: Engages users with SEO-optimized content focused on educating and nurturing users in the early stages of their research.

organic-search-high-intent.title: Organic Search (High Intent)
organic-search-high-intent.description: Attracts users through SEO for high-intent keywords, focusing on converting visitors who are ready to make a purchase.

organic-social.title: Organic Social
organic-social.description: Builds brand awareness and engagement through regular, non-paid social media posts to grow and nurture an organic following.

other.title: Other
other.description: Unpredictable results, but with high potential for growth and unique opportunities. Ideal for building strong, long-term relationships and brand advocacy.

free-community-groups.title: Free - Community Groups
free-community-groups.description: Engages with potential users through active participation in relevant community groups like Slack or Discord to generate organic leads.

cold-email.title: Cold Email
cold-email.description: Initiates direct outreach to targeted prospects via personalized emails, aiming to generate interest and conversions from a cold audience.

influencer-marketing.title: Influencer Marketing
influencer-marketing.description: Leverages influencers to promote your product to their engaged audience, driving traffic and conversions through trusted recommendations.

paid-social.title: Paid Social funnel building blocks
paid-social.description: Select and customize the key building blocks to construct your Paid Social funnel, from initial engagement to final conversion.

social-approval-status.description: Focus on Belonging. Appeal to the deep need to be accepted, admired, and validated by others or a specific community.

superiority-winning.name: Superiority & Winning
superiority-winning.description: Focus on Ambition. Trigger the desire to be better than others, achieve mastery, lag behind no one, and keep up with the best.

care-for-loved-ones.name: Care for Loved Ones
care-for-loved-ones.description: Focus on Protection. Connect with the powerful instinct to ensure the safety, health, and happiness of family and dependents.

comfort-convenience.name: Comfort & Convenience
comfort-convenience.description: Focus on Ease. Showcase a lifestyle free of hassle, offering better living conditions and physical satisfaction.

vitality-longevity.name: Vitality & Longevity
vitality-longevity.description: Focus on Health. Appeal to the innate desire to survive, possess boundless energy, and extend life and youthfulness.

taste-sensory-pleasure.name: Taste & Sensory Pleasure
taste-sensory-pleasure.description: Focus on Cravings. Trigger the visceral enjoyment of food and beverages, focusing on the sensory experience and satisfaction.

attraction-companionship.name: Attraction & Companionship
attraction-companionship.description: Focus on Connection. Tap into the desire for romantic success, personal magnetism, and finding a partner.

the-face-of-distress-portrait.name: The "Face of Distress" Portrait
the-face-of-distress-portrait.description:
A high-quality close-up focusing on micro-expressions of stress, anxiety, or physical pain caused by the problem.

E.g.,: "A business owner burying their face in their hands over a pile of tax letters."

the-chaotic-before-snapshot.name: The "Chaotic Before" Snapshot
the-chaotic-before-snapshot.description:
A raw, unfiltered look at the problem state in its natural environment. Validates the struggle without words.

E.g.,: "A kitchen counter completely overflowing with dirty dishes and zero prep space."

the-internal-monologue-overlay.name: The "Internal Monologue" Overlay
the-internal-monologue-overlay.description:
A relatable complaint or intrusive thought presented as large typography on a plain or muted background.

E.g.,: "Large text over grey: 'I am so tired of waking up with back pain every single day.'"

the-pattern-interrupt-warning.name: The Pattern Interrupt Warning
the-pattern-interrupt-warning.description:
An urgent visual cue (red cross, stop sign, or caution tape) identifying a common mistake the user is making.

E.g.,: "A red 'X' over a cotton swab being used to clean an ear, implying danger."

the-visual-metaphor.name: The Visual Metaphor
the-visual-metaphor.description:
An exaggerated or artistic representation of the pain to make an invisible problem feel tangible.

E.g.,: "A heavy iron chain attached to a runner's ankle to represent fatigue."

the-in-crowd-group-shot.name: The "In-Crowd" Group Shot
the-in-crowd-group-shot.description:
A candid shot of a group of attractive or successful people enjoying the product together.

E.g.,: "A group of friends laughing at a rooftop party, holding the beverage."

the-fomo-notification.name: The "FOMO" Notification
the-fomo-notification.description:
A UI-style graphic showing social proof, waitlists, or exclusive invites stacking up.

E.g.,: "A phone lock screen showing 5+ notifications: 'Your table at [Venue] is ready'."

the-validation-glance.name: The "Validation" Glance
the-validation-glance.description:
A subject using the product while receiving admiring or approving looks from peers in the background.

E.g.,: "A person wearing the watch, with a colleague noticeably looking at their wrist."

the-user-generated-collage.name: The "User Generated" Collage
the-user-generated-collage.description:
A grid layout of 4-6 real customers using the product, creating a "bandwagon" effect.

E.g.,: "A mosaic of selfies showing different people wearing the same sunglasses."

the-exclusive-badge-esthetic.name: The "Exclusive Badge" Esthetic
the-exclusive-badge-esthetic.description:
Minimalist design focusing on the product as a membership pass or symbol of a tribe.

E.g.,: "The credit card centered on black velvet, lighting highlighting the metal texture."

the-us-vs-them-split-screen.name: The "Us vs. Them" Split Screen
the-us-vs-them-split-screen.description:
A direct visual comparison showing your product's superior result against a generic competitor.

E.g.,: "Left side: Dull, yellow teeth. Right side: Bright white smile after use."

the-winners-podium-moment.name: The "Winner's Podium" Moment
the-winners-podium-moment.description:
The end-state of achievement. The user looking powerful, accomplished, and in control.

E.g.,: "A gamer leaning back in their chair with a 'Victory' screen reflected in their glasses."

the-secret-weapon-reveal.name: The "Secret Weapon" Reveal
the-secret-weapon-reveal.description:
Showcasing the product as the unfair advantage that explains the user's success.

E.g.,: "A laptop open with analytics charts, captioned: 'How I doubled sales in a week.'"

the-stacked-benefits-list.name: The "Stacked" Benefits List
the-stacked-benefits-list.description:
A checkmark list design showing feature superiority, overwhelming the viewer with value.

E.g.,: "A list of 10 features checked off vs. only 2 checked for 'Other Brands'."

the-power-move-action.name: The "Power Move" Action
the-power-move-action.description:
Freezing the moment of peak performance or mastery enabled by the product.

E.g.,: "A golfer at the exact moment of a perfect swing drive."

the-protector-embrace.name: The "Protector" Embrace
the-protector-embrace.description:
A warm, intimate shot of a parent/owner shielding or hugging their loved one (child/pet).

E.g.,: "A mother wrapping a soft blanket around a sleeping toddler."

the-peace-of-mind-monitor.name: The "Peace of Mind" Monitor
the-peace-of-mind-monitor.description:
A shot of the user relaxing, knowing their loved ones are safe thanks to the product.

E.g.,: "A dad drinking coffee while looking at a baby monitor app showing a sleeping infant."

the-hidden-threat-contrast.name: The "Hidden Threat" Contrast
the-hidden-threat-contrast.description:
Visualizing a microscopic or invisible danger that the product eliminates.

E.g.,: "A split image of a dog's water bowl: one side dirty (microscope view), one side pure."

the-happy-future-projection.name: The "Happy Future" Projection
the-happy-future-projection.description:
An aspirational image of the loved one thriving, growing, or succeeding in the future.

E.g.,: "An older dog running energetically like a puppy in a field."

the-gift-of-love-unboxing.name: The "Gift of Love" Unboxing
the-gift-of-love-unboxing.description:
The reaction shot of a loved one receiving the product as a gift. Pure joy.

E.g.,: "A child's eyes lighting up as they open the educational toy box."

the-feet-up-relaxation.name: The "Feet Up" Relaxation
the-feet-up-relaxation.description:
The user doing absolutely nothing while the product does the work.

E.g.,: "A woman reading a book while a robot vacuum cleans the floor in the background."

the-one-click-visualization.name: The "One-Click" Visualization
the-one-click-visualization.description:
A graphic representation of speed. From desire to result in a single step.

E.g.,: "A finger hovering over a 'Book Now' button, with the destination already visible behind."

the-chaos-vs-zen-slider.name: The "Chaos vs. Zen" Slider
the-chaos-vs-zen-slider.description:
A before/after slider graphic showing a messy process vs. the streamlined solution.

E.g.,: "Left: A tangle of cables. Right: A single wireless charging pad."

the-macro-comfort-texture.name: The "Macro Comfort" Texture
the-macro-comfort-texture.description:
Extreme close-up of soft materials, foam, or ergonomic curves to evoke sensory relief.

E.g.,: "A memory foam pillow compressing slowly under a hand press."

the-on-the-go-lifestyle.name: The "On-The-Go" Lifestyle
the-on-the-go-lifestyle.description:
The product seamlessly fitting into a busy life without adding friction.

E.g.,: "Someone drinking a meal replacement shake while walking briskly to a meeting."

the-inner-glow-portrait.name: The "Inner Glow" Portrait
the-inner-glow-portrait.description:
Subject looking radiant, with clear skin, bright eyes, and an aura of health.

E.g.,: "A woman with no makeup smiling into the sun, skin looking hydrated."

the-boundless-energy-action.name: The "Boundless Energy" Action
the-boundless-energy-action.description:
A dynamic shot of movement that defies age or fatigue.

E.g.,: "An older man hiking up a steep hill without looking out of breath."

the-data-backed-chart.name: The "Data-Backed" Chart
the-data-backed-chart.description:
A scientific or pseudo-scientific diagram showing improvement in biological markers.

E.g.,: "A graph showing a steep rise in 'Focus Levels' over 30 days."

the-natural-source-hero.name: The "Natural Source" Hero
the-natural-source-hero.description:
The product surrounded by fresh, raw ingredients to imply purity and life force.

E.g.,: "The supplement bottle exploding with fresh lemons, ginger, and splashing water."

the-morning-routine-flatlay.name: The "Morning Routine" Flatlay
the-morning-routine-flatlay.description:
An aesthetic arrangement of healthy habits implying a disciplined, high-performance life.

E.g.,: "Yoga mat, green juice, and the product laid out on a wooden floor."

the-bite-anticipation.name: The "Bite" Anticipation
the-bite-anticipation.description:
The split second before consumption, or the moment of the first bite. High appetite appeal.

E.g.,: "Teeth about to sink into a burger with cheese dripping down."

the-texture-macro.name: The "Texture" Macro
the-texture-macro.description:
Extreme zoom on the physical properties: crunch, fizz, melt, or steam.

E.g.,: "Condensation rolling down a cold soda can."

the-ingredient-explosion.name: The "Ingredient" Explosion
the-ingredient-explosion.description:
Deconstructed view of the components flying in the air to show freshness and quality.

E.g.,: "Strawberries and cream colliding in mid-air."

the-eyes-closed-reaction.name: The "Eyes Closed" Reaction
the-eyes-closed-reaction.description:
A person completely lost in the moment of enjoyment, shutting out the world.

E.g.,: "A person savouring a piece of chocolate with eyes closed."

the-perfect-serve-setting.name: The "Perfect Serve" Setting
the-perfect-serve-setting.description:
The product plated or presented in an idealized, moody atmosphere.

E.g.,: "A cocktail on a marble bar with dramatic lighting."

the-magnet-effect.name: The "Magnet" Effect
the-magnet-effect.description:
The subject becoming the center of attention in a room after using the product.

E.g.,: "A man entering a room, with blurred figures in the background turning heads."

the-intimate-close-up.name: The "Intimate" Close-Up
the-intimate-close-up.description:
A shot implying closeness, chemistry, or touch between two people.

E.g.,: "Two faces very close together, smiling, creating a sense of magnetic tension."

the-confidence-walk.name: The "Confidence" Walk
the-confidence-walk.description:
Full body shot of the user moving with undeniable self-assurance and sex appeal.

E.g.,: "A woman walking down the street, hair flowing, looking unstoppable."

the-digital-desire-ui.name: The "Digital Desire" UI
the-digital-desire-ui.description:
A graphic showing digital success in dating: matches, DMs, or heart reactions.

E.g.,: "A phone screen popping with 'New Match' notifications."

the-glow-up-reveal.name: The "Glow Up" Reveal
the-glow-up-reveal.description:
A subtle before/after implying the product unlocked the user's attractiveness potential.

E.g.,: "Split screen: 'Shy' vs 'Confident' version of the same person."
